Objective of the assignment: The project "Just and Climate Resilient Urban Development and Decentralisation in Zambia" (CitiZen+D), implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), supports urban development and decentralisation in Zambia in four output areas: Output 1: The coordination, planning, and implementation capacities of selected cities for equitable and climate-resilient urban development have been improved. Output 2: The financial capacities of selected cities for equitable and climate-resilient urban development have improved. Output 3: The participation of civil society actors, especially women, in the implementation of equitable and climate-resilient urban development has improved. Output 4: The professional exchange between government and civil society actors on successful approaches to equitable, climate-resilient urban development has improved. Under Output 1, the programme supports the development of 1 Planning Agreement and 5 Local Area Plans (LAPs) in the cities of Choma, Mazabuka, and Livingstone in Southern Province and Mansa and Samfya in Luapula. In 2025 the programme was focusing on the selection of informal settlements in the respective cities and on developing a planning and implementation framework for the development of the LAPs. Based on this the LAP process was initiated in Mansa and Livingstone. To progress with the remaining cities CitiZen+D is looking for a contractor supporting the preparation of three LAPs and one Planning Agreement in Choma (LAP), Samfya (LAP), and Mazabuka (LAP). The location of the Planning Agreement is yet to be determined. The local area plans are meant to: - Guide sustainable land use and development, for example safeguard natural sensitive areas, such as for water catchment and wildlife - Improve infrastructure and service delivery - Support climate change adaptation - Align with national and regional planning strategies The contractor will assist local authorities in designing a participatory planning approach that integrates climate resilience while including the views and opinions of residents, including women, elderly, youth and other marginalized groups. To achieve active inclusion and consideration of communities and marginalized groups, the contractor will sub-contract civil society organizations for the LAP in Choma and Mazabuka through a financing instrument (local subsidy). In order to strengthen planning capacities and use of Geographic Information Systems the contractor is expected to implement and coordinate a local subsidy with the University of Zambia (UNZA). Once the Local Area Plans are approved the contractor shall support local authorities in developing a comprehensive and context-sensitive implementation concept for the LAPs targeting the selected settlements. This concept will outline actionable strategies, institutional frameworks, and phased interventions to formalize land tenure, improve access to basic services (water, sanitation, waste management, and mobility), and enhance housing conditions while preserving community livelihoods. The concept needs to explicitly emphasis on identifying, structuring, and accessing viable financing options to ensure real-world execution. The output will empower local authorities and partners to move beyond planning into funded, scalable, and accountable implementation that delivers tangible improvements in housing, infrastructure, and livelihoods for informal settlement residents. This includes strengthening of resource mobilisation in local authorities. The assignment is structured in the following work packages to be implemented by the contractor: Work Package Title Work Package 1 Climate resilient local area planning and planning agreements Work Package 2 CSO support for inclusive Local Area Plans (LAPs) Work Package 3 GIS capacities for local authorities Work Package 4 Financing models for LAP implementation Work Package 5 Strengthening national dialogue Work Package 6 Strengthening resource mobilisation Work Package 7 Support processes (Expert Pool)

This tender presents an opportunity for potential tenderers to bid for the contract regarding Metroselskabets new CRM and Broadcast-solution (the solution). Metroselskabet needs an integrated platform to support the commercial and operational management of its DOOH and OOH advertising business across the Copenhagen Metro. Metroselskabet is in the process of bringing the commercial management of advertising activities across the Copenhagen Metro in-house. These activities have previously been managed externally, and the transition therefore involves establishing the necessary internal organization, processes, systems and capabilities to enable Metroselskabet to take direct responsibility for its advertising business. The procurement of the solution is a key part of this transition. The Solution is expected to provide the technological foundation for Metroselskabet’s future advertising operations and support the new organization in managing the advertising value chain efficiently and consistently from sales through campaign execution and follow-up. The Customer seeks a standard, cloud-based platform that enables Metroselskabet to manage its advertising business from end to end. The Solution is expected to provide the commercial team with the tools needed to manage customers and sales opportunities, prepare quotations, check available advertising inventory, agree on pricing and book campaigns. Once a campaign is sold, the same Solution is expected to support campaign planning, creative handling and approval, scheduling and broadcasting, followed by monitoring of campaign delivery, Proof-of-Play, invoicing-basis and reporting. The Solution is expected to provide a connected workflow between these activities, ensuring that information established during the sales process can be used directly in subsequent planning, execution and reporting without unnecessary re-entry or manual transfer of data.

Palvelua tuotetaan läsnäpalveluna tilaajan tiloissa ja etäpalveluna. Mahdollisia hankintamenettelyssä kilpailutettavia erikoislääkäripalveluita, joissa henkilöstövaatimuksena muun muassa ovat: -psykiatrian erikoislääkärit (lastenpsykiatria, nuorisopsykiatria, psykiatria, oikeuspsykiatri) -psykiatriaan erikoistuvat lääkärit ja päihdelääketieteen erityispätevyyden omaavat lääkärit tai lääkärit, jolla on vahva osaaminen ja kokemus vaikeiden päihdehäiriöiden hoidosta (vähintään 2 vuotta työskentelyä päihdehoidon yksikössä). Edellä mainittujen palveluiden lisäksi toimittajarekisterin sisällä voidaan hankkia myös muita erikoislääkäripalveluita. Selvyyden vuoksi todetaan, että hankintamenettelyllä ei hankinta vuokratyövoimaa. Tämä on hankintaa koskeva osallistumispyyntö, johon kilpailutuksiin mukaan haluavien markkinatoimijoiden tulee jättää osallistumishakemus Tarjouspalvelu.fi-portaalissa. Kaikki osallistumispyynnön soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät markkinatoimijat valitaan mukaan toimittajarekisteriin. Hankintayksikkö julkaisee tarjouspyyntöjä, joihin vain toimittajarekisteriin hyväksytty tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen. Markkinatoimijat voivat koska tahansa toimittajarekisterin voimassaolon aikana jättää osallistumishakemuksen (31.8.2030 saakka) ja näin mahdollistaa osallistumisen seuraavaan toimittajarekisteriä koskevaan kilpailutukseen.
